coaching.headline: A deathless nine-kill Lt. Belica game drove the win, with both Fangtooths and four enemy towers taken and every allied structure standing.

flags.text: Lt. Belica's damn triple on Neon, Adele and Wraith ended at the Fangtooth pit, just before Kaelen's Fangtooth.
River buffs went 13 to 6 to the allies; the enemy dealt 756 objective damage all game.
Scarlett ate 12,243 magical hero damage with no magical armor built; four deaths, the most among allies.

focus.title: Turn mid kills into prizes
focus.action: When mid wins a fight, the team moves straight onto the nearest tower or Fangtooth, and Scarlett trades into Countess or Aurora only with Kaelen close or magical armor finished.

17.8.call: Won 3-1 on mid: Lt. Belica killed Countess and Adele, Scarlett killed Aurora, then Neon killed Kaelen; the enemy duo inner fell soon after. Right fight, right follow-up.

20.1.call: Won 4-0 in the enemy half: Scarlett killed Countess and Aurora on the offlane, Argus killed Neon on mid, and Skylar finished the mid outer before Lt. Belica killed Adele in the enemy base.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Three Neon kills on mid in the enemy half, plus 976 hero damage per minute against a 764 norm. Open on Neon whenever Seismic Assault is ready.
Mid outer was the last of four enemy towers to fall despite the Neon kills on mid. After the next Neon kill, call Skylar onto the mid outer.
25bf68d7-3ab6-408e-8803-4e37bfef332d: Both deaths to Countess landed on the offlane in our half: first blood, then seconds after the Aurora and Adele double. With Countess unseen, reset after a kill.
Six kills, four on Aurora, yet zero assists and 26% kill participation. When Kaelen catches a target with Winter's Pursuit, follow with Swan Song for the kill.
6238356e-c099-4498-bc7c-465b667810aa: Finished the duo and mid outer towers and cleared four enemy wards, the game's most. Keep taking the tower last hit whenever a won fight leaves a minion wave nearby.
Hero damage ran 495 per minute against a personal 812 average. When Kaelen roots a group with Frostfall, aim Atomiser at the lowest-health rooted hero.
09bba0d1-c58f-4573-89df-a3ee1d3dce46: Zero deaths, 35% kill participation, the second Fangtooth, and 2,168 crest healing from Tranquility. Keep firing Grace as each grouped fight starts.
Eleven wards against Adele's twelve, with two enemy wards cleared. Before each Fangtooth, fill Tranquility's raised ward cap around the pit.
Rotated off the duo lane for kills on Countess and Neon on mid; the mid outer fell shortly after the Neon kill. Repeat the trip once the duo outer falls.
1e663810-34f2-4c71-862a-8a2486d56e84: Took the first Fangtooth, led all ten players with 12,643 objective damage counting camps, and farmed 30 enemy-jungle minions. Keep invading whenever Countess shows on the far side.
Both deaths came to Neon on mid in the enemy half, the first right after a kill on Neon. After a kill there, back out toward Lt. Belica.
Skylar's lone death came to Countess in our jungle shortly after the first Fangtooth. When Countess dives Skylar, hold Frostfall to root Countess.

matchup: Neon was the lane opponent; both Neon kills landed on Kaelen, never on the allied mid.
None of the four enemy heroes killed by the allied mid built magical armor.
build: Combustion, finished before the first Fangtooth, adds area damage on ability hits, with a cooldown that shortens on hero hits.
Noxia marks a hero on ability damage; a separate ability on the mark deals bonus max-health damage, on a cooldown.
Wraith Leggings, the third item of the most played core into Neon, never got built.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage to the major.
Lotus is clearly the field's best mid Eternal; Vesh, the most played, ranks fifth of five with enough games.
Tithe of Death with Mind Rot is the most played Vesh pair; Lich with Mind Rot is the best pair.
augment: Devastating Bombs makes Void Bomb deal more damage to isolated targets.
Combat Veteran is clearly the field's best mid augment; Devastating Bombs, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a few seconds.
Soulbearer leans ahead as the field's mid crest. Sound keep.
improvement: Lane record into Neon: 52% over 205 games. The most played core into Neon ends on Wraith Leggings, 55.8% in 43.
Combat Veteran over Devastating Bombs: movement speed and passive experience, giving up bonus Void Bomb damage on isolated targets.
Lotus over Vesh: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the ability damage over time.

matchup: Aurora, the lane opponent, roots with Hoarfrost and stuns with Cryoseism, both area crowd control.
Countess dealt 9,281 magical damage to heroes and Aurora 8,908, the enemy's two biggest magical damage dealers.
build: Forticus grants physical armor and tenacity, yet only 2,839 of the hero damage taken was physical.
Terminus turns overhealing from lifesteal into a shield.
Vanquisher, finished last, executes heroes taken below a small health threshold; only the final fight had Vanquisher.
eternal: Knell shreds both armors with Rust stacks on hero hits and keeps a share; Fracture adds damage at maximum Rust.
Knell is clearly the field's best offlane Eternal. Sound keep; Patina with Peal is the best Knell pair.
augment: Scarlet Dawn cuts First Intent's cooldown on ability, empowered Cindara and Third Strike hits.
Volcaic Slam and Coup De Grâce lead a toss-up in the offlane field; Scarlet Dawn ranks third of three.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Brutallax and Gravitum lead a toss-up; Judgement, the most played, ranks fifth of six crests with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Aurora: 48% over 228 games. Alternator, Tainted Blade and Mutilator, the 62.3% core in 69 games, went unbuilt.
If Countess and Aurora again lean magical, Mistmeadow Buckler over Forticus adds magical armor, giving up physical armor and tenacity.
Brutallax over Judgement, both Champion Crest evolutions, trades Thunder Cleaver's area heal for a debuff cleanse and tenacity.

matchup: The allied duo with Argus faced Wraith and Adele; the enemy duo died twice before minute ten, the allied duo never.
Wraith never scored a kill and died three times, twice on the duo lane in the enemy half.
build: Resolution and Mindrazor both scale with max mana: Resolution's on-hit damage and Mindrazor's bonus physical power.
Mindrazor, finished after Resolution, splashes basic-attack damage around the target.
Neither item belongs to the winning core of Plasma Blade, Vanquisher and Imperator.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after hitting a low-health hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a dash or leap.
Xyris and Demiurge lead a toss-up in the carry field; Weald, the most played, ranks third of four with enough games.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair; Dryad's Boon with Wind-Rider has too few games to rank.
augment: Assault MK-II extends Air Assault's hover and fires an extra missile with each attack.
Assault MK-II leans ahead in the carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's Purifying Guard active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield.
Pacifier is clearly the field's best carry crest; Liberator, the most played, ranks second of three with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Wraith: 50.4% over 72 games. Lightning Hawk, Scattershot and Equinox, the 55.3% core in 257 games, went unbuilt.
Pacifier over Liberator trades the cleanse and shield for a dash and an empowered physical hit, on the same Sharpshooter Crest path.

matchup: Adele was the lane opponent: zero kills and six deaths, with twelve wards placed.
Adele's hero damage was mostly true damage, 3,509 true against 1,535 physical.
Countess was the dive threat on the backline, with Feast's suppress.
build: Azure Core shields on falling to low health and adds magical power once Font's max-mana stacks fill.
Magnify, finished last, shreds magical armor on ability hits; the final fight was already underway when Magnify landed.
No item from the winning core, Timewarp, Tainted Scepter and Dynamo, made the build.
eternal: Demiurge raises item stats and item-effect damage; Construct adds health and ability haste per level.
Demiurge has too few support games to lead; Vesh and Aion lead a toss-up in the support field.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator's projectiles infinite range, faster travel and a longer slow.
Arcane Engine and Infinite Obliteration lead a toss-up in the support field. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's Grace heals nearby allies and adds brief damage mitigation; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Leafsong and Tranquility, the most played, lead a toss-up in the support field. Sound keep.
improvement: Lane record into Adele: 47.3% over 101 games. Physical armor, the noted need, went unbuilt; with zero deaths, no change is proven.
Caustica, Combustion and Entropy win 62.8% in 43 games; Caustica over Magnify ignores part of magical armor, giving up health and omnivamp.

matchup: Countess was the jungle opponent, with 12,172 healing, the most of all ten players.
Kills on Wraith and Adele came on the duo lane in the enemy half, plus Countess on mid in our half.
build: Tainted Blade cuts a target's healing for a short time after dealing physical damage.
Mistmeadow Buckler spends charges to block part of incoming magical damage.
Neither item is in the best jungle core, Basilisk, Tainted Guard and Forticus, at 68.3% in 240 games.
eternal: Krix adds max health that grows by level; Predator grants bonus damage and speed after camp leader kills, longer on epic monsters.
Idrisil is clearly the field's best jungle Eternal; Krix, the most played, ranks fourth of seven with enough games.
augment: Relentless Hunt adds Razorstorm strikes per attack speed owned, but Rimeglass stops granting armor.
No finished item or the crest added attack speed, the stat Relentless Hunt scales on.
Last Winter is clearly the field's best jungle augment; Relentless Hunt ranks third of three.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver heals on hero hits; crest healing from Warrior Crest through Judgement came to 853 of 10755 total.
Nyr Warboots is clearly the field's best jungle crest; Judgement, the most played, ranks seventh of eight with enough games.
improvement: Into Countess, Tainted Bastion (bought 11%, winning 63.4%) cuts magical attackers' healing but drops Mistmeadow Buckler's physical power.
Last Winter over Relentless Hunt: Frostfall speeds nearby allies and shields on landing, giving up the attack-speed Razorstorm strikes.
Nyr Warboots over Judgement trades area damage and healing for health, both armors and a speed-and-regen active, from a different base crest.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
ourKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
ourKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

ourKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
ourKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
ourKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
ourKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
enemyKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
enemyKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
enemyKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
enemyKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

enemyKits.combo: Cast basic abilities to build 3 Thread, then Overclock Data Burst to slow and Mesmerize, follow with L.I.N.X true damage and an Erase Vector dash into the exploding Jolt; Final Thread Overclocks everything and its recast bomb finishes low targets.
enemyKits.winCondition: Chunk enemies with Overclocked abilities in lane and teamfights, then use Final Thread to chain several Overclocked casts and execute with the bomb.
enemyKits.passive: Neural Network: every 3 basic ability casts Overclock her next basic ability for an extra effect.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners or engage supports who keep enemies in Data Burst range and give her time to cycle Thread.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch her Thread count and respect the next ability when she is at 3, since Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerizes. Dodge the lobbed Data Burst before it detonates, and engage after Erase Vector is spent, which is her only dash. Magic armor helps but L.I.N.X return and pulse are true damage.

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
enemyKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip dashes in, Eventide and Blade Siphon hit to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast suppresses the Haemorrhaged target for bonus damage and full healing, with Shadow Slip recast to swap back out
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast a Haemorrhaged squishy for bonus damage, heal it back, and escape through the Shadow swap
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with two abilities within a short window applies Haemorrhage, a max-health true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her engage, so peel or punish after it is spent; note where her Shadow was left, since she can swap back to it; magic armor and anti-heal blunt her Blade Siphon and Feast healing

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 21 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch.
Neural Disruptor at top rank: 85s base, about 70.8s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Noxia 20.
Lt. Belica dealt 20,488 hero damage, 31% of their team's, with +175 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9; against Neon (level 13 estimated: about 42 magical armor, 33 after penetration) and Adele (level 13 estimated: about 51 magical armor, 42 after penetration) that is about 7% and 6% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Noxia. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 20 ability haste brought them back 17% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor. No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Lt. Belica 0 times.
Copy it? Too few Lt. Belica midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

bullets: Void Bomb or Seismic Assault marked heroes for Noxia; a follow-up hit from a different ability then dealt 6% of that hero's maximum health, once per cooldown.

Combustion added a blast on the target and nearby enemies when an ability landed, then went on a cooldown that every later hit on heroes shortened.
